```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Check and load required packages
required_packages <- c("tidyverse", "DT", "readxl", "plotly", "readr", "dplyr", "tibble", "knitr", "gt", "htmltools")

# Function to safely load packages
safe_load_package <- function(pkg) {
  if (!require(pkg, character.only = TRUE, quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg, dependencies = TRUE)
    library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}

# Load all required packages
for (pkg in required_packages) {
  safe_load_package(pkg)
}
```

```{r data-config, cache=TRUE, cache.lazy=FALSE, include=FALSE}

# Set timeout for downloads (120 seconds)
options(timeout = 120)

# =============================================================================
# EXTERNAL DATA URLS CONFIGURATION
# =============================================================================
# All external URLs are centralized here for easy maintenance.
# To add new datasets, add a new entry to the appropriate species list.
# Supported data types: exon_cv (coefficient of variation matrices)

data_urls <- list(
  Apul = list(
    species_name = "Acropora pulchra",
    italic_name = "*Acropora pulchra*",
    exon_cv = "https://gannet.fish.washington.edu/v1_web/owlshell/bu-github/timeseries-molecular-calcification/M-multi-species/output/42-sample-exon-count/apul-cv_matrix.tsv"
  ),
  Peve = list(
    species_name = "Porites evermanni",
    italic_name = "*Porites evermanni*",
    exon_cv = "https://gannet.fish.washington.edu/v1_web/owlshell/bu-github/timeseries-molecular-calcification/M-multi-species/output/42-sample-exon-count/peve-cv_matrix.tsv"
  ),
  Ptuh = list(
    species_name = "Pocillopora tuahiniensis",
    italic_name = "*Pocillopora tuahiniensis*",
    exon_cv = "https://gannet.fish.washington.edu/v1_web/owlshell/bu-github/timeseries-molecular-calcification/M-multi-species/output/42-sample-exon-count/ptua-cv_matrix.tsv"
  )
)

# =============================================================================
# HELPER FUNCTIONS
# =============================================================================

# Function to validate URL
validate_url <- function(url) {
  if (is.null(url) || length(url) == 0 || !is.character(url)) {
    return(FALSE)
  }
  if (grepl("^https?://", url)) {
    return(TRUE)
  }
  return(FALSE)
}

# Function to create download button with validation
create_download_button <- function(url, filename, button_text) {
  if (!validate_url(url)) {
    warning(paste("Invalid URL provided:", url))
    return("")
  }
  
  if (is.null(filename) || length(filename) == 0) {
    filename <- "download"
  }
  
  if (is.null(button_text) || length(button_text) == 0) {
    button_text <- "Download"
  }
  
  # Return HTML as a string that can be directly output
  paste0('<a href="', url, '" class="btn btn-primary" target="_blank" download="', filename, '">', button_text, '</a>')
}

# Function to safely get row count
safe_nrow <- function(df) {
  if (is.null(df) || !is.data.frame(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(0)
  }
  return(nrow(df))
}

# Function to load data with appropriate parameters and better error handling
load_data_file <- function(url, data_type, species_code, max_retries = 3) {
  if (!validate_url(url)) {
    warning(paste("Invalid URL for", data_type, "data in", species_code))
    return(data.frame())
  }
  
  # Try loading with retries
  for (attempt in 1:max_retries) {
    result <- tryCatch({
      # Show progress
      if (attempt == 1) {
        message(paste("Loading", data_type, "for", species_code, "..."))
      } else {
        message(paste("  Retry attempt", attempt, "for", data_type, species_code))
      }
      
      # TSV-based files (CV matrices)
      if (data_type %in% c("exon_cv")) {
        read_delim(url, delim = "\t", col_names = TRUE, show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE)

      } else {
        warning(paste("Unknown data type:", data_type))
        return(data.frame())
      }
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      if (attempt < max_retries) {
        Sys.sleep(2)  # Wait 2 seconds before retry
        return(NULL)  # Signal to retry
      } else {
        warning(paste("Failed to load", data_type, "data for", species_code, "after", max_retries, "attempts:", e$message))
        return(data.frame())
      }
    })
    
    # If we got a valid result, check and return it
    if (!is.null(result) && is.data.frame(result)) {
      if (nrow(result) == 0) {
        warning(paste("Empty data for", data_type, "in", species_code))
      } else {
        message(paste("  ✓ Loaded", nrow(result), "rows"))
      }
      return(result)
    }
  }
  
  # If all retries failed
  return(data.frame())
}

# =============================================================================
# DATA LOADING
# =============================================================================

message("Starting data load for all species...")

# Define available data types for plasticity analysis
plasticity_data_types <- c("exon_cv")

# Load all data files with error handling
all_data <- list()
data_loading_errors <- character()

for (species_code in names(data_urls)) {
  message(paste("\n===", data_urls[[species_code]]$species_name, "==="))
  all_data[[species_code]] <- list()
  
  for (data_type in plasticity_data_types) {
    url <- data_urls[[species_code]][[data_type]]
    if (!is.null(url)) {
      data_result <- load_data_file(url, data_type, species_code)
      
      if (nrow(data_result) == 0) {
        data_loading_errors <- c(data_loading_errors, 
                                 paste(species_code, data_type, "failed to load"))
      }
      
      all_data[[species_code]][[data_type]] <- data_result
    }
  }
}

message("\n=== Data loading complete ===")

# Report any loading errors
if (length(data_loading_errors) > 0) {
  warning("Data loading errors occurred:\n  ", paste(data_loading_errors, collapse = "\n  "))
} else {
  message("All data loaded successfully!")
}
```

```{r feature-counts}
#| echo: false
# Generate feature counts table dynamically with error handling
feature_counts <- data.frame(
  Species = character(),
  Exon_CV = integer(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (species_code in names(data_urls)) {
  # Safely get row counts with error handling
  exon_cv_count <- safe_nrow(all_data[[species_code]]$exon_cv)
  
  feature_counts <- rbind(feature_counts, data.frame(
    Species = data_urls[[species_code]]$italic_name,
    Exon_CV = exon_cv_count,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ))
}

# Store the feature counts for use in the main content
feature_counts_data <- feature_counts
```

## Summary of Available Data

The coefficient of variation (CV) of exon expression per gene provides a measure of expression plasticity. Higher CV values indicate greater variability in exon usage across samples, which may reflect alternative splicing or differential exon utilization under varying conditions.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
# Display the feature counts summary table
if (nrow(feature_counts_data) > 0) {
  feature_counts_data |>
    gt() |>
    tab_header(title = "Gene Counts with CV Data") |>
    fmt_number(columns = c("Exon_CV"), decimals = 0) |>
    cols_label(Exon_CV = "Exon CV Genes") |>
    cols_align(align = "center", columns = c("Exon_CV")) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
      locations = cells_body(columns = c("Exon_CV"))
    ) |>
    print()
} else {
  cat("No feature count data available.")
}
```

## About the Data

::: panel-tabset
## Exon CV

The coefficient of variation (CV) matrix represents the variability of exon expression within each gene across samples. For each gene, the CV is calculated as the standard deviation of exon-level expression divided by the mean, providing a normalized measure of expression variability. This metric captures expression plasticity at the exon level, which may reflect:

-   **Alternative splicing events**: Genes with high CV may utilize different exons under different conditions
-   **Differential exon usage**: Environmental or developmental changes may shift which exons are predominantly expressed
-   **Regulatory complexity**: Higher CV values may indicate more complex post-transcriptional regulation

Genes with consistently low CV values show stable exon usage patterns, while those with high CV demonstrate greater plasticity in their transcript isoform composition.
:::

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
# Generate all species sections with proper HTML rendering
for (species_code in names(data_urls)) {
  species_info <- data_urls[[species_code]]
  
  # Output species header
  cat(paste0("# ", species_info$italic_name, "\n\n"))
  
  # Generate each data type section
  for (data_type in plasticity_data_types) {
    url <- species_info[[data_type]]
    
    # Skip if no URL defined for this data type
    if (is.null(url)) next
    
    df <- all_data[[species_code]][[data_type]]
    
    # Check if data was loaded successfully
    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
      data_type_display <- switch(data_type,
        "exon_cv" = "Exon CV",
        data_type
      )
      cat(paste0("## ", data_type_display, " - Data Not Available\n\n"))
      cat("Data could not be loaded for this section.\n\n")
      next
    }
    
    # Label for section
    data_type_display <- switch(data_type,
      "exon_cv" = "Exon CV",
      data_type
    )
    
    # File name
    filename <- paste0(species_code, "_", data_type, ".tsv")
    
    # Section header
    cat(paste0("## ", data_type_display, "\n\n"))
    
    # Download button - use HTML directly as a string
    download_btn <- create_download_button(url, filename, paste0("Download ", data_type_display))
    if (download_btn != "") {
      cat(download_btn, "\n\n")
    }
    
    # URL display
    cat("``` bash\n", url, "\n```\n\n")
    
    # Table caption
    cat(paste0("**", species_code, "_", data_type, " (first 4 rows)**\n\n"))
    
    # Display table
    tryCatch({
      df |>
        slice_head(n = 4) |>
        gt() |> 
        print()
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("Error displaying table:", e$message, "\n")
    })
    
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```
